## Names

<a id="save_colours_script"></a>
### [`save_colours_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L6) `$1DA8-$1DC0`

*data*

Script: saves the colours of the picture before the menu uses the screen: screen RAM $5c00 to $c000, colour RAM $d800 to $c3e8, the background colour ($5bff) to $c7d0.

<a id="copy_1000_ram_script"></a>
### [`copy_1000_ram_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L12) `$1DC1-$1DC2`

*data*

Script: copies 1000 bytes with all RAM visible. Destination and source come from the argument stack (op 14).

Script: copies 1000 bytes with I/O visible. Destination and source come from the argument stack.

<a id="show_picture_script"></a>
### [`show_picture_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L22) `$1DD3-$1DEE`

*data*

Script: turns on the bitmap mode ($14ed) and puts the saved colours back: $c000 to $5c00, $c3e8 to $d800, $c7d0 to the background colour ($5bff).

<a id="startup_script"></a>
### [`startup_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L28) `$1DEF-$1E08`

*data*

Start-up script: sets the background of the picture ($c7d0) to 1 and copies it to $d7e8 and $dfe8 (RAM under the I/O). Then op 9 calls disk_protection.

<a id="clear_colours_script"></a>
### [`clear_colours_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L34) `$1E09-$1E19`

*data*

Script: fills the screen colours at $c000 with $e8 and the colour RAM copy at $c3e8 with 0 (1000 bytes each, fill_1000_script).

<a id="init_picture_script"></a>
### [`init_picture_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L39) `$1E1A-$1E2F`

*data*

Script at the start of the main program: clears the picture (new_picture_script), then copies the bitmap $6000 to $8000 and to $e000.

<a id="wipe_program_script"></a>
### [`wipe_program_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L44) `$1E30-$1E39`

*data*

Script: fills $1000-$4e7f with 0 (2 times 8000 bytes). It has no SEI op. The disk protection runs it ($3989).

<a id="new_picture_script"></a>
### [`new_picture_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L48) `$1E3A-$1E3F`

*data*

Script: clears the colours (clear_colours_script) and fills the bitmap $6000-$7f3f with 0.

### [`clear_8000_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L51) `$1E40-$1E41`

*data*

Script: fills 8000 bytes at the destination with 0.

<a id="save_undo_script"></a>
### [`save_undo_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L61) `$1E51-$1E72`

*data*

Script: copies the picture to the undo buffer: bitmap $6000 to $8000, $c000 to $d000, $c3e8 to $d400, $c7d0 to $d7e8 (RAM under the I/O).

<a id="restore_undo_script"></a>
### [`restore_undo_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L68) `$1E73-$1E94`

*data*

Script: copies the undo buffer back to the picture: $8000 to $6000, $d000 to $c000, $d400 to $c3e8, $d7e8 to $c7d0.

<a id="save_picture_a000_script"></a>
### [`save_picture_a000_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L75) `$1E95-$1EA1`

*data*

Script: copies the bitmap $6000 to $a000, then saves the colours (save_colours_script).

<a id="restore_picture_a000_script"></a>
### [`restore_picture_a000_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L79) `$1EA2-$1EAE`

*data*

Script: copies the bitmap $a000 to $6000, then shows the picture with its saved colours (show_picture_script).

<a id="copy_8000_ram_script"></a>
### [`copy_8000_ram_script`](../../../../src/script/picture_buffers.asm#L83) `$1EAF-$1EB5`

*data*
